title: GAMMALN's own fresh gate: b32, 1,600 never-probed rows across two bands
status_plain: b32 is the only fresh-corpus, per-surface figure GAMMALN has, and the arguments in it are GAMMALN captures. The B2 band scores 549 of 1,200 and the B1 band 123 of 400. b32 is also the gate that decided the landing: a candidate that formally passed the held2 gate at 317 lost the fresh gate at 505 of 1,200, and the held-blind pick won at 549. The word the source uses for b32 is "fresh" and "never-probed".

retractions.withdrawn_claim: GAMMALN's pre-landing baseline is "0/79 exact (worst 1,370 ULP)"
retractions.superseded_by: 0/79 worst 1,370 is GAMMA's figure, measured on `answers-r0.json` (156 rows: 79 positive + 77 negative). GAMMALN's own 79-row corpus is `answers-gammaln.json`. Excel's own GAMMALN sits within 2.03 ULP of true loggamma on that corpus, so a 1,370-ULP GAMMALN deviation at large x is arithmetically unavailable.
